contentChanges: Paladin class retains Guard and Cleansing March, which prevents new Poison and Curse while exploring.
All 14 Paladin hammers grant Censure, randomly lowering Armor or Resistance on successful debuff application.
All six Paladin trinkets grant Smite while equipped; the starting Tin Oath Token is equipped.
Smite deals modest magic damage and receives a sixfold bonus while its target has an active Censure Resistance reduction.
Replaces original equipment art across six families and three artifacts, with separate action symbols and native normal-Attack glyphs.
changelog: Paladin 1.3.0 overhauls equipment and action artwork, adds Censure to every Paladin hammer and Smite to equipped Paladin trinkets, and includes the starting Tin Oath Token. Retains Cleansing March and the 1.2.0 balance values: Vitality 80 and Highward/Mercy/Censure/Verdict great-hammer damage 32/34/34/37. Requires framework 1.2.0.
